correctness.rationale: Higashitani–Jochemko–Michałek tight-edge criterion reduces facets to integer 1-Lipschitz potentials with connected spanning nonzero-edge graph. Short arm enforces pole difference Δ=0,±1,±2; on long arms admissible words number 6 (Δ0) or 3 (other Δ) and short-arm patterns 2,1,2. S_m permutes long arms, pole swapping and global sign yield explicit letter involutions. Burnside counts six-color multisets with two fixed letters+two swaps (fixed H_m), three-color multisets with outer-color swap (fixed floor(m/2)+1), and short-branch Δ±1 classes with no further multiset identification. Multinomial orbit sizes sum to known total. Independently built color-multiset orbit representatives (not checker source) for m=2,3,4 and found class counts (13,4,6),(32,6,10),(70,9,15): 23,48,94, matching formula. Analytical count proves all m; finite verification is not general proof.
